book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Matsh gam i e wantsh g wewaꞌakkokam cheposig
Tki am hahawa wantsh k kuhpiꞌo g wewaꞌakkokam cheposig hegai mo kahwalkaj ab e chehgidch. Kuki gam hu wabsh i pi shahmuni an dahm kahchim ch ed am huꞌi eda hugkam ohla.
Kuni haha wabsh ha neid hegam wewaꞌak anghil moki am gegok Jiosh tahgio. Mtki idam ab i ha mahkhi g wewaꞌak kukuikud.

Kuki am kehk g iagchulidakud kownal daikud baꞌich. Tki heg wui am hema ep jiwia g anghil k g ohla haꞌa uꞌa. Kumtki am eda geꞌe toꞌi g s-ap uhwchu mat ab wo i wehnad g ha-hoꞌigeꞌidalig g Jiosh hemajkamga k am wo iagchul Jiosh wui.
Kutki g anghil mehi g s-ap uhwchu. Tki g kuhbs ab amjed am uhgk i chesh wehnadk g ha-hoꞌigeꞌidalig g hemajkam.
Tki am hahawa bei g mehi ab amjed g iagchulidakud heg hekaj ohla haꞌa k am iawua jewed dahm. Kutki am shaꞌi si kop g tataniki k si s-kaidag. Kuki g wepgi an tohonnod ch g jewed si uꞌugij.
Matsh am wo e kuhu g kukuikud
Tki hegam wewaꞌak anghil mo uꞌa g wewaꞌak kukuikud am i e nako mat wo ku.

Tki g wehpeg anghil am si kuhu g e-kuikudkaj. Tki g chea ch mehi wehnadch g ehꞌed ab i e iawua an dahm g jewed. Kutki hemako tahpani mei g jewed mo waik e tahpanch (⅓). Kutki g kukui hab waꞌap masma haꞌas meitto. Tki g washai wehs meitto.

Tki g gokkokam anghil am hahawa epai kuhu g e-kuikudkaj. Tki am haꞌichu e daꞌich ge shuhdagi ch ed ch hab sha mahs mo g ge geꞌe doꞌag ch meihim. Tki hemako tahpani mo waik e tahpanch g ge shuhdagi wabsh e ehꞌedch.
Tki haꞌakia ep koi g haꞌichu doakam am ge shuhdagi ch ed ch haꞌakia ep wachkk g wapalko am shuhdagi ch ed.
Tki g waikkokam anghil am hahawa ep ku. Tki g geꞌe huꞌu ab i gei dahm kahchim t amjed k hab masma meihim mo g kuhchki ch maꞌish g hemako tahpani mo waik e tahpanch g aꞌakimel ch shohshonkam shuhdagi.
K hab chehgig ihda huꞌu S-siwkam. Kutki g hemako tahpani mo waik e tahpanch g shuhdagi wabsh ge siwa. Tki muꞌi hemajkam koi chum iꞌik ihda shuhdagi no pi si s-siw.

Tki g giꞌikkokam anghil am hahawa epai kuhu g e-kuikudkaj. Kutki g hemako tahpani mo waik e tahpanch g tash ch mashad ch huhuꞌu ge chuku. Kutki heg hekaj haꞌas huhug g ha-tonlig ch haꞌas tash pi tonod tash oidam ch chuhug oidam.

Nt am hahawa ep i nen k kah. Kuki si s-kaidam hab kaij g baꞌag an uhgk daꞌadch, “Eh, si s-ta ehbidama! Dat wo si s-ta ehbidamak am ha wehhejed hegam mo an kih jewed dahm mat ab wo kaida g kuikud ab ha amjed hegam waik anghil mat am ep wo kuhk.”
